voices.name: Alexandra - Conversational and Natural
voices.description: Youthful and authentic, with a conversational tone that's relatable and down-to-earth.

voices.name: Siren - Natural realistic conversational voice
voices.description: This voice is perfect for podcasts, videos, social media, commercials...really ANYTHING where you need a hyper-realistic voice that sounds so chill and natural, no one would guess it's not a human.

voices.name: Brielle - Podcast girl extremely natural
voices.description: Looking for a gen Z voice for social media, that is completely natural and real sounding? Nothing that is gonna have people saying "that sounds like AI" but is instead un-clockable?? Give Brielle a chance and you will not be disappointed.

voices.name: Bella -  Chatty Social Media Influencer
voices.description: A younger sounding, american female voice, Bella E has a high-quality sound, and her voice is currently one of the top social media voices used.
